templates.title: Gas Safety Certificate (CP12)
templates.description: Annual gas safety check by a Gas Safe registered engineer. Give a copy to tenants within 28 days.

templates.title: Electrical Installation Condition Report (EICR)
templates.description: Electrical safety inspection by a qualified electrician, at least every five years.

templates.title: Energy Performance Certificate (EPC)
templates.description: Required before marketing a property to let. Valid for ten years.

templates.title: Smoke & CO Alarm Test Record
templates.description: Record that alarms were tested and working on the first day of each tenancy.

templates.title: Legionella Risk Assessment
templates.description: Assessment of water system risk. Review every two years or when the system changes.

templates.title: PAT Test Certificate
templates.description: Portable appliance testing for furnished lets. Recommended annually.

templates.title: Fire Risk Assessment
templates.description: Required for HMOs, common areas and commercial premises. Review annually.

templates.title: Tenancy Agreement
templates.description: Signed agreement for the current tenancy.

templates.title: Deposit Protection Certificate
templates.description: Proof the deposit is protected in a government-approved scheme, with prescribed information.

templates.title: How to Rent Guide (signed receipt)
templates.description: Evidence the current How to Rent guide was given to tenants (England).

templates.title: Right to Rent Check
templates.description: Copies of identity documents checked before the tenancy started (England).

templates.title: Inventory & Check-in Report
templates.description: Condition report signed by the tenant at the start of the tenancy.

templates.title: Landlord Insurance Policy
templates.description: Buildings and landlord liability cover. Renew annually.

templates.title: Rent Guarantee Insurance
templates.description: Optional cover against missed rent and legal costs.
